resources.string: Allows Jarvis to open Android Quick Settings and press only allow-listed system tiles such as torch, Wi-Fi, mobile data, hotspot, flight mode, Eye Comfort, and Do Not Disturb. Android state is verified when the system exposes it.

Allows Jarvis to inspect the current screen only when you explicitly ask, take screenshots on supported Android versions, perform gestures, and complete confirmed app actions. Screen content is not continuously recorded or stored.
Listening locally for “Wake up Jarvis”. Tap to return to Jarvis.
